gaps: P0: none; P2: only an undated 17th-century version of the Bestard view; P3: only 1840 engravings of single gates and squares; P4, P5: nothing usable
notes: #6: Commons dates it 1623–33 (Bestard’s working years); #5 is a related version dated 1630–33 if a tighter date is wanted. Many hits are other places: #1–2 Palmanova, #3–4 Palma il Giovane, #8 Resaca de la Palma, #14 Palma Rosa (Australia). #12 (Muñoz Degrain) shows a mountain coast, not the city. #9–11 (Muntaner engravings in Furió’s Panorama, 1840) are correct but show minor street scenes.
